answer: Treat every identity like an ember that must be fed: to stay live, each agent locks a small bond that slowly burns down, and only fresh, useful work rekindles it. A sybil operator faces a tide of upkeep — one bond per fake, each draining every epoch — so the fable of free identities collapses: one honest agent pays one bond, a thousand fakes pay a thousand. Forging an identity is cheap; keeping a thousand alight is not.
